name: Sodi
title: Father of the spy Gaddiel from the tribe of Zebulun
summary: Sodi is known from the Bible as the father of Gaddiel, who was chosen to represent the tribe of Zebulun among the twelve spies that Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan. He is mentioned only briefly in Numbers, but his son played a role in the important reconnaissance of the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Sodi's son Gaddiel chosen as a spy
keyEvents.description: Gaddiel, son of Sodi, was chosen to represent the tribe of Zebulun among the twelve spies that Moses sent to explore the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The twelve spies are sent out
keyEvents.description: Moses sent twelve men, including Gaddiel son of Sodi, from the wilderness of Paran to spy out the land of Canaan by the Lord's command.

keyEvents.title: The spies explore the land of Canaan
keyEvents.description: The twelve spies, including Gaddiel son of Sodi, explored the land of Canaan for forty days and returned with fruit from the land.

keyEvents.title: The spies' report and the people's rebellion
keyEvents.description: After their return, most of the spies gave a negative report about the land of Canaan, which led to the people rebelling against the Lord and Moses, resulting in Israel wandering in the wilderness for forty years.
